C1519.title: Over 40 Fake Crypto Wallet Extensions Found on Firefox Add-on Store
C1519.summary: In July 2025, security firm Koi disclosed the FoxyWallet campaign and linked more than 40 Firefox extensions to one malicious cluster. The extensions impersonated major cryptocurrency wallets including Coinbase, MetaMask, Trust Wallet, and Phantom, copying legitimate names and interfaces to induce installation. Once installed, they stole wallet credentials and secret information and sent it to attacker-controlled servers.
